debit.notes: Customer care hours are 08:00am to 10:00pm (all days of the week); 1800-425-0426 is the national toll-free line and +91 9842 461 461 the chargeable all-services customer-care number. The bank's contact-page FAQ directs holders of a lost or compromised ATM/debit card to call 044-26223106 / 26223109 immediately to block it. No overseas hotline is published; NRIs are given the email desk nricell@tmb.bank.in. Online blocking runs through internet banking via the site's 'Online Service Requests (Stop Payment, Card Block/Unblock)' page; the TMB MBank app lists debit card management among its features, but no app menu path is published. No SMS hotlist format appears on official pages.

credit.notes: Credit-card queries share the general customer-care lines (1800-425-0426 toll-free, +91 9842 461 461; hours 08:00am to 10:00pm all days). The same contact-page FAQ that covers 'ATM/Debit/Credit cards' says to call 044-26223106 / 26223109 immediately for a lost or compromised card, and gives the credit-card-specific line 0461-2383346 with email creditcardcell@tmb.bank.in. The bank's 'Credit Card Portal' self-service web channel is at apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/crcrdonline/; no mobile-app blocking path or SMS hotlist format is published for credit cards. No overseas hotline is published (NRI email nricell@tmb.bank.in).
